```{r cover-path, include=FALSE}
# Path for LaTeX must use forward slashes even on Windows
cover_path <- here::here("images", "report", "cover-background.png")
cover_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", cover_path)
```

```{r font-path, include=FALSE}
# Absolute path of the fonts directory (forward slashes, OS-independent)
font_dir <- gsub("\\\\", "/", here::here("fonts"))
if (!file.exists(file.path(font_dir, "LeagueGothic-Regular.ttf"))) {
  stop("Font not found : ", file.path(font_dir, "LeagueGothic-Regular.ttf"),
       "\nCheck that fonts/LeagueGothic-Regular.ttf is committed in the repo.")
}
```

\newfontfamily\coverfont[Path=`r font_dir`/, Extension=.ttf]{LeagueGothic-Regular}

\AddToShipoutPictureBG*{
  % --- Full-page background image ---
  \AtPageLowerLeft{
    \raisebox{0pt}[0pt][0pt]{%
      \hspace*{-1mm}%
      \includegraphics[
        width=\dimexpr\paperwidth+2mm\relax,
        height=\dimexpr\paperheight+2mm\relax, keepaspectratio=false
      ]{`r cover_path`}
    }
  }
  % --- Title and subtitle, centered horizontally, upper third of the page ---
  \AtPageCenter{
    % Title : resized to fill 90% of the page width
    \raisebox{9.5cm}{%
      \makebox(0,0){%
        \color{white}\coverfont%
        \resizebox{0.9\paperwidth}{!}{1~FORMULA}%
      }
    }
    % Subtitle, raised a bit higher to add breathing room above the equation
    \raisebox{5.3cm}{%
      \makebox(0,0){%
        \color{white}\sffamily\fontsize{34}{40}\selectfont One equation. 817 drivers. One answer.
      }
    }
    % --- Backpropagation (adjoint / Neural ODE) equation, discreet decoration, two lines ---
    \raisebox{2.1cm}{%
      \makebox(0,0){%
        \color{white!50!black}%
        \resizebox{0.62\paperwidth}{!}{$
          \begin{gathered}
            \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial \theta} = -\int_{t_1}^{t_0}
              \lambda(t)^{\top} \frac{\partial f\big(a(t), t; \theta\big)}{\partial \theta}\, dt,
            \qquad \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial a_0} = -\int_{t_1}^{t_0}
              \lambda(t)^{\top} \frac{\partial f\big(a(t), t; \theta\big)}{\partial a}\, dt \\[6pt]
            -\frac{d\lambda(t)}{dt} =
              \left[\frac{\partial f\big(a(t), t; \theta\big)}{\partial a}\right]^{\!\top} \lambda(t),
            \qquad \lambda(t_1) = \nabla_{a(t_1)} \mathcal{L}
          \end{gathered}
        $}%
      }
    }
  }
  % --- Author, discreet, bottom right corner ---
  \AtPageLowerLeft{
    \raisebox{1.5cm}[0pt][0pt]{%
      \hspace*{\dimexpr\paperwidth-1.2cm\relax}%
      \llap{%
        \color{white}\sffamily\bfseries\fontsize{22}{24}\selectfont JEAN-MARIE ROY%
      }
    }
  }
}
